reviews.text: Great team of staff. We were very pleased with the vet assessment and prescriptions that saved our old dog's life rather than make another referral to a specialist with expensive tests. Staff also reviewed options with prices listed.

The best experience we’ve had with a Vet. From the time we walked in the staff (noemy) was friendly, professional and helpful. When we got sent to the room the tech was super patient and loving with our pug since she was uneasy. When the doctor came in she was focused on our pug’s care and she offered the best care and answered all questions we had . 10/10 experience.
Hi Brit. thanks for reviewing us! We're happy to know that you've had a great experience and look forward to seeing you again soon!
Friendly staff and excellent service was provided! Follow up text to check on our dog Mimi was also a nice touch.
Immediately they ask for a $50 deposit then charge you $35 for a nail clipping over charging for this service is wrong!

This was our first time meeting Dr. Williams, and we had a wonderful experience. Dr. Williams was incredibly patient with our dog, and we’re excited to see how this new medication helps. The entire team genuinely cares about every animal that comes through their doors, and it shows in the compassion and pride they bring to their work. Thank you all so much for taking such great care of our pup!
Care was prompt and all staff/vet/tech were very nice and efficient.

Brought my green-cheek conure in for nails and feather trim. Tech clipped nails too short with bleeding and informed needed to keep pet for observation until late afternoon. Charged for extra time watching pet which more than doubled cost of service. They made a mistake and then charged me to monitor their pet for their mistake...doesn't seem reasonable. Switched to another provider since this occured.
Ms Sedona was so well taken care of by Dr Williams and all of the staff. So glad we have a new veterinarian office to bring our fur babies to.
Complete trust with Dr Hously and Dr Elliott
Thank you, Kassandra, for your 5-star rating! We're thrilled to know you had a positive experience with us. We look forward to serving you again!

Amazing place!! I cannot stress enough how awesome the staff is. My dog is anxious and pretty annoying at the vet and previous clinics made us give her meds before coming in and wanted us to sedate her (hundreds of dollars) to do the cushings blookwork test. Not Ahwatukee Animal Care- they are great with my dog & have no issues getting her blood work done & expressing anal glands. She is also way less scared to go to the vet than she ever used to be! They do not over charge either:-) Huge bonus. HIGHLY HIGHLY HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!!!!!!
Thank you, Anne, for your 5-star rating! We're thrilled to know you had a positive experience with us. We look forward to serving you again soon!

Thank you, Alejandro, for your 4-star rating! We're glad to see your positive feedback and look forward to serving you again. If you have any specific thoughts or suggestions, feel free to share them with us.

Both my pups have seen Dr. Williams on numerous occasions, even when they are just being diva's. EVERY time, she and her staff are patient, caring, and always there to help! Trusted vet care is valuable, and I'm glad this spot provides the reliability and service I always need. Thank you always Dr. Williams!

They answered the phone ask you if this an emergency if you just needed care could you hold on please then never return back to the phone it's rings then back to the wait recording over and over again.I eventually hung up after a lengthy wait first time trying to do business I won't never call them again period.... Overpriced I can't get my time back
Great place. I have been coming for years.

To our Husky Aspen in for shots and ear check up and we rec’d excellent service. They were kind and gentle with my timid husky and provided  a lot of information about her ear issue and how to care for it.

Thank you to Dr. Bley and her technicians. Woke up today and found a kitten stuck in my car engine. After the mechanic was able to get him out, called here and they saw me right away, made sure the kitten is okay and gave me some emergency carrier and litter to be able to take care of this unexpected surprise.
Thank you, Anna, for your 5-star rating! We're thrilled to know you had a positive experience with us. We look forward to serving you again soon!
Excellent staff and veterinarians
Very Nice caring people!! Dr. Pesque is very warm and friendly.
Paid for 2 dogs to be fixed..but one only had 1 ovary removed..and the other dog had neither removed..but also had her colon cut..it has not been a great experience.
Thank you, C S, for your 5-star rating! We're thrilled to know you had a positive experience with us. We look forward to serving you again soon!

The vets are seemingly good. The first time I came back to them (I left during Covid because of their policies, but decided to give them another chance) I had an appt and they took walk ins before me so I had to wait an hour. Then,the front of house staff, specifically Sabrina, could use some work in the follow up/ manners department. No, I won’t be back. miss Dr Jenkins!!
Thank you, Jacob, for the 5-star rating! We're thrilled to know you had a positive experience with us. We look forward to serving you again!
Dr. Williams impressed me as a wonderful vet that really cares.  She spent time with me explaining procedures and was open to questions.  I am grateful to have found her to care for my dog and cat.

I have taken my sick dog to DR Williams 7 times over the last two weeks! She is so caring - she checks in and says bring Riley anytime.  She has congestive heart failure- which just happened on January 7th.  This week, after all the care, she is feeling good, taking shorts walks and back to herself. So grateful!!

Ahwatukee Animal Care Hospital provides great care for your furry friends. I’ve been able to leave Daisy for a couple years. She runs towards Melissa, Faith, Elora, and others when we arrive. She comes home healthy and happy. I have a new addition to our home, Max. He spent his first overnight a couple days ago. When I picked up Daisy and Max, he was a content, little guy. I am so pleased with this facility and team. Both Daisy and Max are small dogs. The photos I attached are the same ones that were forwarded to me after their “spa time”.
I like that they keep you updated and check in to see how your pet is doing after treatments
It’s so nice to be able to walk in on a Saturday when your dog needs medical treatment. The Staff was so caring and compassionate. The Vet was amazing she truly cares.Thank you so much
My dog has been several times for boarding.  Always had excellent service and peace of mind for me.  I hope they keep it.
I love them. They take such great care.
THE STAFF WAS EXCELLENT
Thank you Ana for your 5 star review!

Great experience overall! Dr. Bley is amazing! Very sweet and welcoming which was great for my 4 year old golden doodle who can sometimes be timid. My parents also saw her for our senior family dog and she handled his passing with a great amount of empathy and care. Definitely recommend them for your 4 legged fur babies!

I took my dog to them for end of life services. The female doctor would not perform the service until I paid them over $ 1700.00 , for blood work and other unnecessary tests.  He died that night! In a pool of his own blood.  Money is more important to them , then the welfare of our pets !    SHAMEFUL

I brought my dog in for the very first time the week before Thanksgiving with my dog Bonnie and I was blown away. My normal vet was closed that evening and to me, this was an emergency. My dog isn’t the easiest to work with and the staff were AMAZING. So patient, kind and didn’t make me feel like an inconvenience at all. I left feeling so relieved and the whole experience was so affordable. I wish I could remember the staffs name who worked with me (I’ll have to check my paperwork) because she deserves huge praise and kudos. She even responded to the automated text with shampoo options for my dog.

I 10/10 recommend this animal hospital. They take pride in their work and their knowledge.

My husband and I brought our 16 year old chihuahua into the office after she injured her back leg. The staff were all very nice, attentive and quick! They genuinely care about what is best for your pets. Four days after we went to the hospital, they even texted me to see how our dog is doing! I definitely recommend this vet's office!
Amazing care for my cat and dog! Fast and friendly service.
brought my Chihuahua in here for the first time and was pleasantly surprised at how friendly the staff was. The front desk, tech and the doctor were all amazing.
Thank you for giving us a 5 -star rating! We're happy to know that you've had a great experience with us and look forward to your next visit.

Sunny was vomiting periodically throughout the week, so I called to make an appointment. However, on Saturday, she was worse, so I took her to AACH, and they immediately took her under their care. Dr. Williams was genuinely concerned and offered suggestions on the best course of action within a tight budget. Dr. Williams was caring and took the time to address Sunny's needs; she even followed up a couple of days later to check on Sunny's condition progress.
Staff is superb. I visited the weekend urgent care and they took care of our cat quickly. Would definitely visit again if needed.
The updated office and exam rooms looks good. AACH provides super customer service.
Hi David thanks for reviewing us! We're happy to know that you've had a great experience and look forward to seeing you again soon!
Each time I took Mikey in for his check ups,  everyone was very professional and polite.  All the Drs. are very caring.

We’re sorry to see that your experience with us did not meet your expectations. Since your review didn’t include any details, we’d really appreciate the opportunity to learn more about what happened. If you’re open to sharing, please contact us directly at +1 480-893-0533 or ahwatukeevet@gmail.com so we can better understand your concerns and work toward a resolution. Your feedback is important to us, and we’re always striving to improve.
I got in right away for my dog emergency. They were amazing and took care of my fur baby right away. Highly recommended them and they're staff

They take such great care for my old and you g dogs. Been to a few vets in Ahwatukee, but they are the only ones that seem to actually care about your pets welling instead of pushing unnecessary procedures will up your bill.

Dr. Williams spent countless hours with me over a year to give me the best final year with my soul cat. We went over every option to keep her happy, comfy, and healthy. Cats can’t live forever and when my sweet girl passed the clinic reached out to me to let me know how sorry they were. It can be hard to find a vet you’re comfortable with, but I can’t imagine taking my pets anywhere else.

These ladies were very rude and contentious. After switching to an online vet where I can chat in and get what I need, prescribed, it has saved me so much money and frustration. This vet was ignoring years of medical history for my dog, an refused to prescribe basic antibiotics unless we submitted to over 2k in tests that she demanded we perform.

My dog recieved her amoxicillin from the other vet and is back to full health within two weeks.

This veterinarian cared more about $$$ than my dogs health.
I been taking my Cupid to this location for 10 years. Staff and doctors is great with my Cupid
Hi Cathy thanks for reviewing us! We're happy to know that you've had a great experience and look forward to seeing you again soon!
This place is terrible, just terrible. They have tried to recommend surgery on my twice, for a stomach ache. And not stomach surgery, knee surgery!!!
Very caring staff. They were able to get me in quickly to address my cat's allergy issue. The doctor was thorough in her exam and recommended a treatment, which seems to be helping.
Hi Patricia thanks for reviewing us! We're happy to know that you've had a great experience and look forward to seeing you again soon!
Hi Guy thanks for reviewing us! We're happy to know that you've had a great experience and look forward to seeing you again soon!

My dog needed her teeth cleaned .... Estimate at Ahwatukee Animal was $2000 ... In Mexico it was done for $180 receiving excellent care  and attention ... Why is dog dental care more expensive than human at Vet Clinics in the US ????

We’ve taken our dogs here for everything from routine checks and shots to nail trims to bee sting swelling. The staff and vet techs are always kind and accommodating! Thanks for all you’ve done for our pups!
